server: tunnel.example.com:7835
name: home
secret: "${HOME_SECRET}"
allow:
  - 10.0.0.5/32:5432
  - 127.0.0.1/32:3000
--- notes

=== client lab Yaml None
server: tunnel.example.com:7835
name: lab
secret: QEFCQ0RFRkdISUpLTE1OT1BRUlNUVVZXWFlaW1xdXl8=
allow:
  - unix:/run/app.sock
--- notes
service "named" targets host name printer.lan; add its IP address to "allow" on the client
=== client lab Yaml Some("ws://tunnel.example.com/burrow")
error: Failure { message: "invalid --server: the server has no websocket section", hint: Some("use the host name, or add a websocket section to the server config"), exit: 2 }
=== visitor laptop Yaml
server: tunnel.example.com:7835
name: laptop
secret: YGFiY2RlZmdoaWprbG1ub3BxcnN0dXZ3eHl6e3x9fn8=
forwards:
  db:
    service: db
    local: 5432
  sock:
    service: sock
    local: 10000
  lab:
    client: lab
    socks: true
    local: 1080
--- notes
127.0.0.1:1080 is a SOCKS5 proxy into client "lab": point an app at it, or forward one target with: burrow visit --client lab --target 10.0.0.1:22 --local 2222
=== visitor phone Yaml
